title: Ichthyosaur and plesiosaur fossils of Lyme Regis
summary: From age twelve, Anning found the first correctly identified ichthyosaur skeleton and the first two nearly complete plesiosaur skeletons on the Dorset coast.
why: Her finds helped show that species had lived and gone extinct long ago.

unsung.contribution: Found and prepared the first correctly identified ichthyosaur and the first near-complete plesiosaurs.
unsung.recognition: As a woman she could not join the Geological Society and often did not receive full credit for her finds.
